subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should manual `/new` and hard `/reset` require a default-on confirmation across all user-facing command surfaces, and should there be any config opt-out?
rationale: The source fix is bounded, but it changes public destructive command behavior and may add config/default surface, which repository policy treats as maintainer product scope.

options.title: Default-on single confirmation
options.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding a config knob unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

options.title: Configurable confirmation
options.body: Add a documented config surface for confirmation behavior and accept the extra schema, docs, migration, and upgrade-review burden.

options.title: Keep commands immediate
options.body: Leave typed `/new` and `/reset` unchanged and focus on non-destructive session creation or recovery improvements elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Default-on single confirmation
recommendation.body: Require one repeated command or explicit confirm action before destructive manual resets, without adding a config knob unless a concrete opt-out need is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the adjacent Control UI confirmation guard and New Chat behavior, making him the strongest history-backed owner for whether that behavior becomes a cross-command contract.
